pills.name: Just the pill / classic L&F
pills.note: §D ERP_BOTTOM_BAR_AND_LIFECYCLE — master toggle. OUR design (default) = just the pill: classic iDempiere chrome (toolbar icons) hidden, the pill IS the UI. Press red pill (or ',' — same shortcut as BIM Doc Mode) → reveal the familiar iDempiere L&F; in classic mode our lens pills step aside (only the red pill remains). Persisted in localStorage. NEVER stage-gated.
